WITH execution_totals AS (
  SELECT
    o.orderbase AS channel,
    AVG(e.fillcount) AS average_filled_quantity,
    COUNT(e.fillcount) AS execution_count
  FROM orders AS o
  JOIN orderexecutions AS e
    ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.orderbase
)
SELECT
  channel,
  average_filled_quantity,
  execution_count,
  1.0 * execution_count / SUM(execution_count) OVER () AS share_of_total
FROM execution_totals;
